name: Pretty public share URLs
objective: Human-readable, durable slug-based public URLs for shared documents and the public graph (org slug + project + doc slug), replacing numeric-ID/UUID links while keeping old links working

review.note: All consolidated validation green, but one blocking cross-slice regression: dateless canonical_path + anonymous id-URL redirect can serve a different document for old share links (confirmed empirically). F1: round-trip guard on canonical_path emission + 201 URL. F2: dashboard slug-change hint copy.
